Actors: Sean Chiplock, Yûsuke Kobayashi, Kayli Mills

Plot: After being suddenly transported to another world, Subaru Natsuki and his new female partner are brutally murdered. However, Subaru awakens to a familiar scene, meeting the same girl again. The day begins to mysteriously repeat it...
